part.Name: RulesDescription
part.Text: Causes a memorum crystal to sprout from your flesh. The memorum crystal can be crushed to return to the moment it was formed. When you die, the memorum crystal will spontaneously disentigrate, bringing you back automatically. Using this while you carry a memorum crystal will change the resonance of the existing crystal. Has no effect on non-player characters.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A translucent crystal. The center bends light around it, absorbing light that would otherwise penetrate. It shifts like a river, glittering in the moonlight.
